nodes.label: Event-driven UI with Streamlit reruns
nodes.rationale: Streamlit reruns the whole script on interaction; st.session_state, st.fragment(run_every=...), and callbacks are used to keep state consistent while rendering live updates without a client-side framework.

nodes.label: Background worker pattern (daemon threads + Job registry)
nodes.rationale: Long-running generation runs in daemon threads via a process-global Job registry (src/jobs.py) so the Streamlit UI thread stays responsive during streaming, OCR, or web search.
nodes.norm_label: background worker pattern (daemon threads + job registry)

nodes.label: Functional module style with typed data carriers
nodes.rationale: Most logic is organized as module-level functions with small dataclasses for structured data (ModelInfo, ApiModel, SelectedModel, Attachment, Job) rather than classes/services, keeping the codebase flat and easy to trace.
nodes.norm_label: functional module style with typed data carriers

nodes.label: Search the public web without credentials; provider failures yield no context.
nodes.norm_label: search the public web without credentials; provider failures yield no context.

nodes.label: Use the canonical Chroma index when configured, with a SQLite lexical fallback.
nodes.norm_label: use the canonical chroma index when configured, with a sqlite lexical fallback.

nodes.label: Local-First Privacy Defaults
nodes.rationale: Cloud providers begin prompt-only and browser-entered credentials remain only in server-process memory for the browser session.

nodes.label: Two-Application Parity Migration
nodes.rationale: The handbook frames the repository as two applications during a parity migration because v2 is not yet end-to-end while legacy retains rich behavior.

nodes.label: Protected Security Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Session ownership, prompt-only remote-provider defaults, quarantine, redacted bundles, and safe provider error categories constrain data exposure.

nodes.label: Hash-Bound Context Preflight
nodes.rationale: A turn is accepted only when its context plan still matches and required safety findings are confirmed; web evidence is cached by plan hash.

nodes.label: Single-Process Localhost Boundary
nodes.rationale: The deployment remains single-process and localhost-first because horizontal scaling would require externalized run events and credential/session state.

nodes.label: Provider Context Policy
nodes.rationale: Cloud context begins prompt-only and expands only under the selected provider policy.

nodes.label: Canonical Data and Explicit Migration
nodes.rationale: data/app.db and data/chroma are canonical; importing a previous v2 database requires explicit confirmation and a SQLite backup.

nodes.label: Credential Nonpersistence
nodes.rationale: Credentials must not be logged, persisted, included in replay bundles, or returned by provider APIs.
